rules: Read current metered spend from `modal billing summary` immediately before launch.
Refuse when the conservative per-job maximum exceeds its declared cap.
Refuse when current plus the declared-attempt estimate exceeds $34.00.
Timeouts and retries are part of the estimate; no unbounded retries.
Treat the per-job estimate as a bound on declared attempts only: Modal may independently reschedule crashed containers.
The unallocated 20% and provider-native hard cap cover platform reschedules, image builds, price drift, and delayed billing data.
Start with control-plane smoke, then minimal T4 smoke, before model workloads.
